Maya (Docs): Quick sync for tomorrow's slimline release note: product wants a single-paragraph customer blurb + a short "how-to-migrate" snippet and one known-issue. Can we keep copy tight so marketing can reuse it? :memo:
Nora (PM): One-liner from PM: 'Embeddings endpoint is consolidated for lower latency — update your clients to use /api/embeddings with model_id by 2026-05-10.' Keep it consumer-friendly.
Sam (SDK): Heads-up: the Node snippet needs a tiny payload change (model -> model_id) and the Python example should include the new timeout param to avoid occasional 504s on large inputs.
Maya (Docs): Paste the exact diffs please so I can patch the code blocks.
Sam (SDK): Old Node:```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?model=embed-x', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hello' }) })
``` New Node:```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ model_id: 'embed-2026-small', input: 'hello' }) })
```
Sam (SDK): Python change: add timeout param to client call:```python
client.embeddings(input='hello', model_id='embed-2026-small', timeout=30)
```
Ethan (Infra): Also note: redwoodctl flag changed from --host to --api-host in 0.9.0. If we reference CLI snippets, update them or add compatibility note.
Maya (Docs): I'll update CLI examples and add an inline compatibility tip: "old clients may use X-Legacy-Model header" with a short curl shim example.
Sam (SDK): Shim example for curl:```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Legacy-Model: true' -d '{"model_id":"embed-2026-small","input":"hi"}'
```
Nora (PM): Add rollback line: if customers see >5% error rate after migrating, revert to the legacy alias by contacting support and include a trace_id; ops will flip the alias back for 48h. Keep that as one short sentence.
docs-ci: linkcheck failed on branch release/slim-embeds (missing redirect for /v1/embeddings) :x:
Maya (Docs): Which pages reference /v1/embeddings?
docs-ci: Found occurrences in docs/snippets/node/embeddings.md and docs/snippets/cli/quickstart.md
Maya (Docs): I'll sweep those two files and push fixes.
Sam (SDK): PR 4210 open with Node/Python snippet updates. Ran unit snippet tests locally.
Ethan (Infra): I've added a staging redirect from /v1/embeddings -> /api/embeddings for the short window, but we should fix canonical links.
Maya (Docs): I'm drafting the known-issue blurb: "Some legacy clients that send `model` instead of `model_id` may receive 400s. Workaround: use the migration shim or update payloads. Contact support for aliasing." OK?
Nora (PM): Good. Short and clear.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for docs-releases/slim-embeds at 14:00 UTC.
docs-ci: build passed on branch release/slim-embeds (checks: linkcheck fixed, snippet-tests) :white_check_mark:
Maya (Docs): Final checklist before merge: 1) replace /v1/embeddings refs (Maya) 2) merge PR 4210 (Sam) 3) update CLI example for --api-host (Maya/Ethan) 4) add rollback sentence and known-issue (Maya) 5) docs-ci green.
Sam (SDK): All merged.
Ethan (Infra): Redirect removed after canonical links fixed.
Maya (Docs): Publishing to staging now. Will ping when live so Marketing can pull the one-liner. Thanks all. :sparkles:
